conf.description: crowdstrike-falcon, audit-activity dataset, syslog-kv format: tokenize the space-separated key=value line (quote-aware) into the crowdstrike.falcon.* namespace by literal key, tag event.dataset. reveal_token/API-key masking recommended by the catalog is NOT implemented -- no concrete field or pattern given.

conf.comment: crowdstrike-falcon / audit-activity / syslog-kv (OperationName=, ServiceName=, UserId=, UserIp=, Success=, ... on the same connector stream as detection-summary). The field table for this dataset+format is empty, so no ECS target is asserted -- every key=value pair is tokenized quote-aware and landed under crowdstrike.falcon.<literal-key>. The catalog's reveal_token/API-key masking recommendation names no concrete field or pattern here, so it is a documented gap, not invented.

functions.description: record the KV tokenization approach and why ECS mapping and masking are both left undone

conf.code: var re = /([A-Za-z0-9_]+)=("([^"]*)"|(\S*))/g; var m; while ((m = re.exec(__e['_raw'])) !== null) { var k = m[1]; var v = (m[3] !== undefined) ? m[3] : m[4]; __e['crowdstrike.falcon.' + k] = v; }
